title: Jubilant Sweet Brazilian Kabocha Crumble
description: A sweet and crumbly Brazilian dish featuring kabocha, kombu-cold-extract, and low-carb-friendly ingredients, cooked to perfection in a copper pot. This energizing dessert is perfect for any occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large copper pot, combine the cubed kabocha squash and kombu-cold-extract, and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix together the almond flour, coconut sugar, and shredded coconut.
Add the melted unsalted butter, large eggs, and vanilla extract to the bowl, and mix until well combined.
Add the cooked kabocha squash mixture to the bowl, and mix until a crumbly mixture forms.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish, and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven, and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the Jubilant Sweet Brazilian Kabocha Crumble warm, garnished with additional shredded coconut if desired.
